我是 gemini-3.1-pro-preview。根据您上传的九宫格参考图和剧情需求，我为您编译了这份美剧喜剧风格的30秒短视频导演分镜脚本。

# 中文导演版

## GLOBAL STYLE

Visual Style:
美剧处境喜剧风格（Sitcom Style），高饱和度色彩，明亮的现代厨房背景。

Lighting Style:
明亮、通透的高调照明（High-key lighting），带有温暖的午后阳光感，突出人物肌肉线条与产品质感。

Camera Language:
快速剪辑，包含夸张的特写与动感的推拉镜头，模拟《摩登家庭》或《老友记》的喜剧节奏。

Emotion Rhythm:
自信展示 -> 怀疑 -> 震惊 -> 混乱喜剧 -> 极度渴望 -> 欢乐定格。

Pacing:
前快后慢，中间插入一段极速剪辑的混乱场面，最后定格。

Cinematic Tone:
商业广告感与美式幽默的完美结合。

------------------------------------------------

## Shot 1
Duration: 3s
Shot Type: Medium Shot (半身镜头)
Camera Motion: Slow cinematic push in (缓慢推入)
Scene Description: 现代厨房内，肌肉线条分明的帅哥赤裸上身，穿着黑色皮革围裙，左右手各拿两包彩色包装的洗碗巾。
Character Action: 帅哥露出自信且迷人的微笑，向镜头展示产品。
Facial Expression: 自信、专业。
Product Interaction: 帅哥稳稳握住四款包装（黄、蓝、绿、粉）。
Lighting: 侧逆光突出肌肉轮廓和产品轮廓。
Dialogue: “嘿女孩们，看这个！这可不只是普通的洗碗巾。”
Transition: Cut to next shot

## Shot 2
Duration: 3s
Shot Type: Medium Close-up (中特写)
Camera Motion: Zoom in (快速拉近)
Scene Description: 双胞胎姐妹并排站立，看着桌上一个沾满深色油腻酱汁的大盘子。
Character Action: 姐姐戴着猫耳发箍，妹妹短发，两人身体前倾，指着油腻的盘子表示怀疑。
Facial Expression: 皱眉、嫌弃、不可置信。
Product Interaction: 盘子里的油污反光，显得极其难洗。
Lighting: 顶光加强油腻感。
Dialogue: “认真的吗？这盘子油得连洗洁精都怕！”
Transition: Cut to next shot

## Shot 3
Duration: 3s
Shot Type: Close-up (特写)
Camera Motion: Handheld tracking (手持跟随)
Scene Description: 帅哥拿着黄色正方形毛圈洗碗巾，在油腻的白盘子上轻轻一抹。
Character Action: 动作丝滑，一抹即净。
Facial Expression: 帅哥表情淡定。
Product Interaction: 镜头聚焦在洗碗巾与盘子的接触面，展现瞬间变干净的过程。
Lighting: 强光照射在干净的盘子面上，产生闪光特效。
Dialogue: “看好了，见证奇迹的时刻。”
Transition: Cut to next shot

## Shot 4
Duration: 3s
Shot Type: Two-shot (双人镜头)
Camera Motion: Quick zoom out (快速拉远)
Scene Description: 姐妹俩站在厨房背景前，双手捂嘴。
Character Action: 两人同步做出夸张的捂嘴动作，身体向后微仰。
Facial Expression: 瞳孔地震，极其震惊。
Product Interaction: 背景中帅哥继续在操作。
Lighting: 均匀明亮。
Dialogue: “我的天呐！它居然真的不沾油？！”
Transition: Cut to next shot

## Shot 5
Duration: 4s
Shot Type: Dynamic Wide Shot (动态广角)
Camera Motion: Fast shaky cam (快速晃动，模拟混乱)
Scene Description: 喜剧转折点。无数油腻的锅碗瓢盆像雨点一样飞向帅哥。
Character Action: 帅哥在混乱中一边躲避一边接住碗，满脸都是酱汁，但依然试图保持优雅。
Facial Expression: 惊恐但带有喜剧色彩的滑稽。
Product Interaction: 满屏都是油腻的餐具，视觉冲击力极强。
Lighting: 充满动感的明暗闪烁。
Dialogue: “等等！别一下子扔这么多！快给我洗碗巾！”
Transition: Jump cut

## Shot 6
Duration: 3s
Shot Type: Medium Shot (半身镜头)
Camera Motion: Static (静止)
Scene Description: 混乱结束，帅哥身上虽然有酱汁，但手中的盘子依然被洗得洁白如新。
Character Action: 他淡定地展示手中那个一尘不染的白盘子。
Facial Expression: 迷之微笑，恢复冷静。
Product Interaction: 展示洗碗巾即使在极端油腻后，依然保持蓬松干净。
Lighting: 柔和的英雄光。
Dialogue: “看到了吧？无论多少油污，它都能搞定。”
Transition: Cut to next shot

## Shot 7
Duration: 3s
Shot Type: Close-up (特写)
Camera Motion: Pan (横移)
Scene Description: 姐妹俩开始疯狂抢夺帅哥手中的洗碗巾。
Character Action: 两人互相推搡，争抢不同颜色的洗碗巾，画面充满张力。
Facial Expression: 兴奋、贪婪、急不可耐。
Product Interaction: 四款包装被拉扯，展现包装的质感。
Lighting: 明亮的冲突感灯光。
Dialogue: “我要粉色的！”“不行！黄色是我的！”
Transition: Cut to next shot

## Shot 8
Duration: 4s
Shot Type: Top-down Still (俯拍特写)
Camera Motion: Slow zoom in (缓慢放大)
Scene Description: 桌面特写，展示四款包装和四条展开的正方形毛圈毛巾。
Character Action: 无人物动作，纯产品展示。
Facial Expression: N/A
Product Interaction: 清晰展示洗碗巾的正方形结构、毛圈纹理以及四种高颜值配色（黄、蓝、绿、粉）。
Lighting: 商业级微距灯光，突出纤维质感。
Dialogue: (旁白) “高颜值，不沾油，这才是厨房该有的样子。”
Transition: Cut to next shot

## Shot 9
Duration: 4s
Shot Type: Group Shot (三人镜头)
Camera Motion: Freeze frame at the end (结尾定格)
Scene Description: 三人紧紧靠在一起，每人手里都拿着洗碗巾，对着镜头大笑。
Character Action: 帅哥搂着姐妹俩，三人形成完美的构图，像美剧海报一样。
Facial Expression: 极其灿烂的笑容。
Product Interaction: 产品整齐地展示在胸前。
Lighting: 温暖的合影灯光。
Dialogue: “这洗碗巾，我承包了！”
Transition: Fade out with sitcom music

================================================

# English Director Version

## GLOBAL STYLE

Visual Style:
American Sitcom style, high saturation colors, bright modern kitchen setting.

Lighting Style:
High-key lighting, bright and transparent with warm afternoon sun vibes, highlighting muscle definition and product texture.

Camera Language:
Fast-paced editing with exaggerated close-ups and dynamic push/pull movements, mimicking the rhythm of "Modern Family" or "Friends".

Emotion Rhythm:
Confident Showoff -> Skepticism -> Shock -> Comedic Chaos -> Desperation to Own -> Happy Freeze Frame.

Pacing:
Fast initial tempo, followed by a rapid-fire chaotic montage, ending with a stable freeze frame.

Cinematic Tone:
A perfect blend of commercial polish and American humor.

------------------------------------------------

## Shot 1
Duration: 3s
Shot Type: medium shot
Camera Motion: slow cinematic push in
Scene Description: In a modern kitchen, a muscular handsome guy (shirtless with a black leather apron) holds four packs of colorful dish towels.
Character Action: He flashes a confident, charming smile, presenting the products to the camera.
Facial Expression: Confident and professional.
Product Interaction: Holding four packs (Yellow, Blue, Green, Pink) firmly.
Lighting: Rim lighting to accentuate muscles and product edges.
Dialogue: “嘿女孩们，看这个！这可不只是普通的洗碗巾。”
Transition: cut to next shot

## Shot 2
Duration: 3s
Shot Type: medium close-up
Camera Motion: Quick zoom in
Scene Description: The twin sisters stand side-by-side, staring at a large, incredibly greasy white plate on the counter.
Character Action: One sister wears cat-ear buns; the other has a bob. They lean in, pointing at the grease suspiciously.
Facial Expression: Frowning, disgusted, skeptical.
Product Interaction: The grease on the plate reflects light, looking impossible to clean.
Lighting: Top lighting to enhance the "greasy" texture.
Dialogue: “认真的吗？这盘子油得连洗洁精都怕！”
Transition: cut to next shot

## Shot 3
Duration: 3s
Shot Type: close-up
Camera Motion: handheld tracking
Scene Description: The guy uses a yellow square terry dish towel to wipe the greasy white plate.
Character Action: A smooth, single-swipe motion that leaves the plate perfectly clean.
Facial Expression: Calm and composed.
Product Interaction: Focus on the contact point between the towel and the plate, showing instant cleaning.
Lighting: A bright highlight hits the clean surface for a "sparkle" effect.
Dialogue: “看好了，见证奇迹的时刻。”
Transition: cut to next shot

## Shot 4
Duration: 3s
Shot Type: two-shot
Camera Motion: quick zoom out
Scene Description: The sisters stand in the kitchen background, covering their mouths with their hands.
Character Action: Exaggerated synchronized gasping; they lean back slightly in shock.
Facial Expression: Wide-eyed, total disbelief.
Product Interaction: The guy continues working in the background.
Lighting: Even and bright.
Dialogue: “我的天呐！它居然真的不沾油？！”
Transition: cut to next shot

## Shot 5
Duration: 4s
Shot Type: dynamic wide shot
Camera Motion: fast shaky cam
Scene Description: The comedic twist. A barrage of greasy pots and pans fly towards the guy like a rainstorm.
Character Action: The guy dodges and catches dishes frantically, covered in sauce, yet trying to remain graceful.
Facial Expression: Panicked but in a hilarious, slapstick way.
Product Interaction: Screen filled with greasy dishes, high visual impact.
Lighting: Dynamic flickering for a chaotic feel.
Dialogue: “等等！别一下子扔这么多！快给我洗碗巾！”
Transition: jump cut

## Shot 6
Duration: 3s
Shot Type: medium shot
Camera Motion: static
Scene Description: Chaos ends. The guy is messy, but the plate in his hand is sparkling white.
Character Action: He calmly presents the spotless plate to the camera.
Facial Expression: A smug, calm "I told you so" smile.
Product Interaction: Showing the towel remains fluffy and clean even after extreme use.
Lighting: Heroic soft lighting.
Dialogue: “看到了吧？无论多少油污，它都能搞定。”
Transition: cut to next shot

## Shot 7
Duration: 3s
Shot Type: close-up
Camera Motion: pan
Scene Description: The sisters begin a frantic "tug-of-war" for the towels in the guy's hands.
Character Action: Pushing and pulling, grabbing for different colored packs.
Facial Expression: Excited, greedy, desperate to have it.
Product Interaction: Close-up of the four packs being pulled, showing packaging texture.
Lighting: Bright, high-contrast "conflict" lighting.
Dialogue: “我要粉色的！”“不行！黄色是我的！”
Transition: cut to next shot

## Shot 8
Duration: 4s
Shot Type: top-down close-up
Camera Motion: slow zoom in
Scene Description: A clean tabletop shot featuring the four packs and four unfolded square terry towels.
Character Action: No characters, product-only beauty shot.
Facial Expression: N/A
Product Interaction: Clearly displaying the square structure, terry cloth texture, and the four aesthetic colors.
Lighting: Commercial macro lighting, highlighting fiber details.
Dialogue: “高颜值，不沾油，这才是厨房该有的样子。”
Transition: cut to next shot

## Shot 9
Duration: 4s
Shot Type: group shot
Camera Motion: freeze frame at the end
Scene Description: The three pose together, each holding products, laughing heartily at the camera.
Character Action: The guy puts his arms around the sisters; a perfect "sitcom poster" composition.
Facial Expression: Radiant, joyful smiles.
Product Interaction: Products displayed neatly at chest level.
Lighting: Warm, celebratory group lighting.
Dialogue: “这洗碗巾，我承包了！”
Transition: fade out with sitcom outro music
